name: rfp-rfi-creation
description: Produce RFI (Request for Information) / RFP (Request for Proposal) / RFQ (Request for Quote) documents. Choice of instrument by intent (RFI = discover, RFP = solution + pricing, RFQ = commodity pricing). Required sections: introduction + business context + evaluation criteria + functional + non-functional requirements + commercial asks + security + compliance asks + SLA asks + timeline + submission instructions + Q&A process + confidentiality. Scoring rubric + weightings. Not legal advice.
